title: Reward or metric name not found
message: The reward or metric {name} was not found.
basic_text: This harness uses a reward or metric that isn't installed.
fix_text: Install the plugin that provides it.

title: A tool needs network hosts that aren't allowed
message: The tool {tool_name} needs network hosts that aren't allowed: {hosts}.
basic_text: A tool in this harness wants internet access you haven't allowed.
fix_text: Allow the hosts in the harness, or remove the tool.

title: Import entry skipped: unsupported transport
message: The entry {entry_name} uses the unsupported transport {transport}; it was skipped.
basic_text: One tool couldn't be imported.

title: Harbor task folder incomplete; task skipped
message: The Harbor task folder {path} is incomplete; the task was skipped.
basic_text: One task couldn't be imported because files are missing.

title: MCP env values not imported; set them as secrets
message: The env values of {server_name} were not imported.
basic_text: Settings that may be secret weren't copied.
fix_text: Set them as secrets in Rastai.

title: Harbor task has no prebuilt image
message: The Harbor task {task_id} has no prebuilt image.
basic_text: This task needs a container image that hasn't been built.
fix_text: Build the image, then set environment.image in the task.

title: Agent Gym command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: Sandbox cap reached
message: The sandbox cap of {cap} is reached.
basic_text: Rastai is already running as many sandboxes as allowed.
fix_text: Wait for some to finish, or raise compute.sandbox_cap.

title: No container engine found
message: No container engine was found.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't run the sandbox this task needs. No container software is installed.
fix_text: Install Podman or Docker.

title: Container engine API version not supported
message: The container engine's API version {version} is not supported.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't run the sandbox this task needs. The container software is too old or too new.
fix_text: Update Podman or Docker.

title: Sandbox image pull failed
message: Pulling the image {image} failed: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't run the sandbox this task needs. Its image couldn't be downloaded.
fix_text: Check the image name and your connection.

title: Sandbox container exited at start
message: The sandbox container exited at start with code {exit_code}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't run the sandbox this task needs. It stopped as soon as it started.
fix_text: Check the image's start command.

title: Sandbox time cap reached
message: The sandbox reached its time cap of {time_seconds} seconds.
basic_text: The sandbox ran out of time and was stopped.
fix_text: Raise the time cap, or make the task shorter.

title: Container engine can't pause sandboxes
message: The container engine can't pause sandboxes.
basic_text: Your container software can't pause sandboxes, so step mode isn't available.
fix_text: Use Podman or Docker with pause support.

title: Not enough RAM for the requested sandboxes
message: The requested sandboxes need {needed_bytes} bytes of RAM, but {free_bytes} are free.
basic_text: This computer doesn't have enough memory for that many sandboxes.
fix_text: Request fewer sandboxes.

title: Requested sandboxes exceed the node's sandbox cap
message: {requested} sandboxes were requested, more than the node's cap of {cap}.
basic_text: You asked for more sandboxes than this computer allows.
fix_text: Request fewer sandboxes.

title: Sandbox egress network or proxy unavailable; refusing an open network
message: The sandbox egress network or proxy is unavailable; Rastai refuses to give the sandbox an open network.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't set up the sandbox's filtered network, so it won't start the sandbox.
fix_text: Check the container engine's network setup.

title: Permission denied on the container engine socket
message: Permission denied on the container engine socket {path}.
basic_text: Rastai isn't allowed to use the container software.
fix_text: Give your user access to the engine's socket, or use rootless Podman.

title: Sandbox killed by its memory cap
message: The sandbox of {rollout_id} was killed by its memory cap.
basic_text: A sandbox used more memory than allowed and was stopped.

title: Container engine failed during the run, or a container can't be removed
message: The container engine failed during the run, or a container can't be removed: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't run the sandbox this task needs. The container software failed.
fix_text: Check the container engine, then try again.

title: Infra failure; rollout retried
message: Rollout {rollout_id} hit an infrastructure failure and was retried.
basic_text: One attempt failed for a technical reason and was retried.

title: Group dropped: too few valid members
message: Group {group_id} was dropped: only {valid_count} valid members.
basic_text: One group of attempts had too few usable results, so it was left out.

title: Too many dropped groups in a row; run failed
message: {count} groups were dropped in a row; the run failed.
basic_text: Too many attempts failed, so the training stopped.
fix_text: Check the harness and the sandboxes.

title: Reward code raised an error; rollout excluded
message: The reward code raised on rollout {rollout_id}: {reason}.
basic_text: The scoring code failed for one attempt, so it was left out.
fix_text: Fix the reward code.

title: Held sandbox released after the hold timeout
message: The held sandbox of {rollout_id} was released after the hold timeout.
basic_text: A paused sandbox was closed because it waited too long.

title: An MCP tool server failed to start in the sandbox
message: The MCP tool server {server_name} failed to start in the sandbox: {reason}.
basic_text: A tool the agent needs didn't start.
fix_text: Check the tool server's command in the harness.

title: A harness tool isn't offered by its server
message: The tool {tool_name} isn't offered by its server {server_name}.
basic_text: A tool the harness lists doesn't exist on its server.
fix_text: Fix the tool's name in the harness.

title: A tool server crashed twice in one rollout; rollout excluded
message: The tool server {server_name} crashed twice in rollout {rollout_id}; the rollout was excluded.
basic_text: A tool kept crashing, so that attempt was left out.
